capabilities: Run LLM-powered commands on note text
Summarize selected text with a built-in TLDR command
Create custom commands with configurable prompts and output actions
Configure settings per command, including text selection and output action
extras: Users must link a credit card to their OpenAI account; new commands only register after reloading the app.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send note content to an LLM for processing such as summarizing or rewriting.

relations.evidence: Get API Key from OpenAI from this page.

summary: AI plugin that runs customizable LLM commands on note text, with a built-in text summarization command as a demo.
